seo_title: Decide where to go on holiday, together | somewhere🎉
seo_description: Can't decide where to go on holiday? somewhere🎉 lets the whole family add ideas, spread points in secret, let a fair draw pick your next trip, then plan it together. Free to use.

hero.heading: Every family has a list of somewheres.
hero.lead: The fair way to decide where to go on holiday: put everyone's ideas in one place, let a draw pick one, and plan the trip together.
hero.note: Free. One of you signs up, everyone else joins with a link.

journey.heading: Follow one idea from the list to the lake

standby.title: Ella puts Lake Garda on standby
standby.text: Anyone in the family can add a place they'd love to go, with the budget, travel time and type of trip. Stuck? Pull ideas from the [destination guides](/destinations).

points.title: Everyone spreads their points in secret
points.text: You each share out your points across the ideas you like and get one veto for the place you really can't face. Nobody sees anyone else's until the draw, so the quietest voice counts as much as the loudest.

draw.title: The draw picks where you go
draw.text: Every point is a ticket in the draw, so the more points an idea has, the better its chances. The departures board knocks ideas out one by one until one gets a seat.

plan.title: You plan the trip together
plan.text: The winner gets its own trip plan: a day-by-day itinerary, a budget that tracks who paid what, and a packing list for each person.

postcards.heading: Once you're home, it becomes a postcard
postcards.text: Every trip fills in your family map and passport, so years of holidays live in one place. Add the ones you've already been on too.

questions.question: Does it cost anything?
questions.answer: No. somewhere🎉 is free for the whole family. Some booking links earn us a small commission, which is [how we keep it free](/how-we-make-money).

questions.question: Does everyone need an account?
questions.answer: No. One of you signs up with an email and shares a private link with everyone else. They pick their name and they're in.

questions.question: What if we don't have any ideas yet?
questions.answer: Browse the [destination guides](/destinations) and add anything that catches your eye straight to your list, or let the [holiday picker](/holiday-picker) suggest somewhere.

cta.heading: Start your family's list of somewheres
